sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
We are stuck. The HUD bar appears to be a progress bar that we can fill with SPACE. The level likely ends when the bar is full (maybe G reaches end of row). Currently G=2, need many more. This seems impossible to finish efficiently. Perhaps the real goal is opposite: we need to empty the bar to zero (i.e., G disappears). That happened when we first got game_over true (G disappeared). So maybe after resetting, we need to press SPACE until G disappears again (i.e., wrap around). But pressing SPACE adds G, not removes. Maybe pressing SPACE cycles: after reaching full, next press resets to empty and triggers game_over. So we need to fill to max then one more press triggers game_over. That would require many presses (~64). Still inefficient.
Maybe there is a hidden mechanic: pressing ACTION7 might instantly complete. But it did nothing. Maybe MOUSE on the bar increments faster? It did nothing. Could be that we need to press SPACE many times but we can batch many in one action call to reduce overhead? The action count still counts each action, but we could send a batch of many SPACE actions in one call; the system will treat each as separate actions, counting them all. So no benefit.
Thus maybe we misidentified level; maybe the actual goal is to press SPACE until game_over true, which we already achieved earlier. After that, the level restarts; maybe we need to press SPACE until game_over again, then press something else to move to next level. But we are stuck in loop.
Perhaps the level is actually already completed and we need to press SPACE to go to next level, but the harness still shows same level number because level hasn't changed? Could be that after game_over, pressing SPACE should advance to next level, but we are stuck because we are still on level 1. Maybe we need to press SPACE twice quickly? Let's try pressing SPACE twice in a batch.
